name: LangGraph PostgresSaver checkpointer
description: Thread-scoped (short-term) LangGraph state persisted as checkpoints in PostgreSQL; package langgraph-checkpoint-postgres. Storage is the user's PostgreSQL (#9).

provenance.notes: Supports version 3.2.0 (uploaded 2026-10-14). The 3.2.0 wheel contains langgraph/checkpoint/postgres with delete_thread and no TTL code; supports_ttl and encryption_at_rest are therefore omitted.

Supports memory_type session (thread_id is the checkpoint primary key) and backing_type relational (PostgresSaver, 'Ideal for using in production'). Encryption is optional via EncryptedSerializer (LANGGRAPH_AES_KEY), not default, so encryption_at_rest is not asserted.
Supports license MIT for the langgraph monorepo that ships the checkpoint libraries.
